status: SUGGESTED MAPPINGS ONLY - not wired into game events. The shared sound director integration is owned by the main agent; until it lands, nothing here plays automatically. No src/ui.js, engine.js or profile files were touched for these clips.
processing: voice_proc.process keep_duration=True, maximum=3.5s, bitrate=56; mono 22050 Hz; decoded peaks <= -1.5 dBFS; <= 60 KiB

munch_mmm.notes: Mouth hum 'Mmm'; occasional savoring after own capture; never idle/looped.

laugh_baby_short.notes: STRICT: only a genuinely silly human move; never routine mocking; never on forced/only-move losses; alternate framing laugh_baby_full shares this quota.

laugh_baby_full.notes: Same take, fuller phrase; shares the single laugh_baby quota with laugh_baby_short.

susp_drone_deep.notes: Deep ominous drone for genuinely long thinks; must never become an idle ticking loop.

susp_drone_creep.notes: Creeping bass for creeping endgame danger.

susp_burst.notes: Sudden burst for an abrupt material swing.

ah_scream.notes: Short comic 'AHH!'; smaller scale than pregnant_shock.

mwah_kisses.notes: Repeated comic mouth-kiss sounds; over-affectionate gag; excerpt of the 6.385-10.515 pattern.

sorry_dontcry.notes: Verbal consolation 'Oh, sorry, sorry, sorry, don't cry.' after a heavy human loss.

dont_cry.notes: Short 'Don't cry.' tag; shares the consolation quota with sorry_dontcry.

g0_bass_sting.notes: Sustained comedic ominous bass sting (excerpt of the 26.145-32.105 sustained sting); momentary, never looped.

comic_hit_bright.notes: Distinct bright hit (corr 0.06 vs comic_hit); shares the punchline pool.

pregnant_shock.notes: Comic 'PREGNANT?!' exclamation for huge surprises (e.g. promotion reveal); wording stable across two ASR models.

g0_deep_wah.notes: Deep comedic sting, distinct color from g0_bass_sting.

sharedQuotas.baby-laugh: laugh_baby_short + laugh_baby_full together: max 1 per game, 300 s cooldown, low chance, never forced losses
sharedQuotas.consolation: sorry_dontcry + dont_cry together: max 2 per game, 180 s cooldown
sharedQuotas.punchline: comic_hit + comic_hit_bright together: max 4 per game, 60 s cooldown
